capabilityErrors.host_not_allowed: The plugin tried to reach a server it was not allowed to contact.
capabilityErrors.https_required: The plugin tried to use an unencrypted (http) address; only https is allowed.
capabilityErrors.fetch_failed: The plugin's request to its server failed (unreachable, too slow or refused).
capabilityErrors.http_body_too_large: The plugin's request body was too large to send (characters such as quotes count more than once).
